strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
So this is the Star of La Mu I've been searching for... With this...
So you've come... foolish demons...!
(Sooner than I expected...! Akira... I will protect the Star of La Mu.
This power is surely... meant for you...)
Hah hah hah! Reiko Hibiki!
...No, Lemuria, daughter of La Mu, king of the ancient Mu Empire!
I won't let you have the Star of La Mu!
...You are the younger Kyoretsu brother... Gekido.
Oho, so you remember me, whose name rang through the demon clan,
even across twelve thousand years!
Hoho... How could I forget that dimwitted face?
Mngh!? Grrr! Enough! Kyoretsu Beasts! Seize that woman!
Kakaka... Princess Lemuria, you mean to anger us and exploit the opening...
but we won't fall for it! Brother, seize her with the Ghostan!
Right, Big Brother! Now, come quietly! Princess Lemuria!
Ngh... Akira...!
Raaaaaaai!
Mmh!?
That's... the legacy of our Mu Empire... Raideen! Akira!
Akira, I know how you feel, but... you ended up rushing out in the end.
Sorry, Mari. I thought I heard Mom's voice...
and I just couldn't sit still.
Eh, what's the harm? Commander Hazuki and the rest will be here soon.
Gahahaha! You may be full of yourself after beating Sharkin,
but we Kyoretsu brothers won't go down so easily! Raideen!
The Kyoretsu brothers!?
That is my younger brother, Gekido! And I am Gorai!
Akira Hibiki, Demon Emperor Barao is most displeased!
You shall atone for your sins with death!
Tch, saying whatever you please... Who do you think you are!?
Akira, let's take 'em all out right here!
Right!
Kakaka! Look at this! Akira Hibiki!
Akira...!
Wha... What's that!?
...Akira, could it be!?
M-Mom! Is that you, Mom!?
Kukuku, as you can see, we have Reiko in our custody.
Tch, taking a hostage... What a coward.
M-Mom! Let go of my mom!
Akira...!
Big Brother! Leave Raideen to me.
Do as you please, Brother.
Mom... I swear I'll get you back!
Don't do anything reckless until everyone gets here! Akira!
...The Mutron ruins and the Demon Empire... This is heating up...!
Wh... Whaaat... Me...? Akira Hibikiii!
I'm taking my mom back! Gekido Kyoretsu...!
Impossible... This is...
It's going down...! It took a direct hit to the power plant...!
Hibiki! Hurry and get your mother...!
Akira!
Mom!
Gekidooo!
Nngh, guooooh... Raideen... Even if I fall... Lord Barao...
Do not underestimate the power of Lord Barao...!
What is that...!?
What is that...!?
It's one of our battleships!
Are you okay!? Akira?
So these are the Mutron ruins?
They're a lot like the Mykene ruins.
Are you ready to sortie?
Is everyone ready to sortie!? All hands, sortie!
Are you all right!? Hibiki!
I'm fine, but my mom...
What happened?
Everyone, don't go attacking all willy-nilly!
What do you mean?
Akira's mother is being held hostage!
Ngh... How despicable...
Don't worry about me. Just go ahead and attack Gorai Kyoretsu's mecha...
please...
B-But then you'll...!
Akira, there's no need to worry!
I have a legacy of Mu... a barrier generator.
Shoot down Gekido Kyoretsu, and me with him!
Whaaat!?
Believe in me... in the power of ancient Mu...
All right, I believe you, Mom...!
Are you sure, Akira?
Yes. I believe in my mother...
It's decided, then. So no holding back... Well, not exactly...
Is she really going to be all right...?
Show! Isn't there some way to get her back!?
...If I can get in close... maybe I can do something?
If she says she'll be fine, then she'll be fine!
Insolent Lemuria!
Bah, no matter! Can we slink off with the Star of La Mu before us!?
Gekido Kyoretsu... I'll beat you and save my mom!
Yes, Mom and I are both safe!
I see... That's good to hear.
Mom, get to one of the battleships where it's safe.
Very well...
Now that we're here, you've got nothing to worry about.
Demons... How dare you take my mom hostage...
All units, wipe out the Demon Empire's mecha!
Oh, oh... Gekido...! Curse you, Raideen! How dare you do this to my brother...!
You're next! Gorai Kyoretsu!
Gekido... I will... I will surely avenge him! Remember this!
That bastard ran off...
What about Mom?
We have just taken her aboard.
Oh, Akira, at last... At last we meet...
M-Mom... It's really... you...!
Tch, and right in the middle of a touching reunion...
He launched them so we couldn't chase after him...
Akira... We'll talk later. For now, focus on the battle...
Yes, Mom!
Nuoooooh! How dare you... How dare you do thiiis!
Too shallow!?
It needs one more push!
To think my Ghostan would take this much damage... Nuoh!?
Now!
She got out!? Akira's mother...!
Escape, escaaape!
Blast it! Wait! Lemuriaaa!
All right! Mom! Are you okay?
Don't worry about me! More importantly, Akira, finish him!
Nngggh! Don't think you've won...
Next time, I'll be sure to snuff you out for good!
Hold it! You running away!?
Don't you worry, the Gyandlar'll be takin' that treasure.
When that time comes, we'll simply take it back from you!
Don't let them escape! Finish them here!
Blast it!
What about Mom?
We have just taken her aboard.
Oh, Akira, at last... At last we meet...
M-Mom... It's really... you...!
Tch, and right in the middle of a touching reunion...
He launched them so we couldn't chase after him...
Akira... We'll talk later. For now, focus on the battle...
Yes, Mom!
Too dangerous, Big Brother. Leave the rest to me and go to Lord Barao.
Nngh... Remember this, Lemuria. Do not underestimate the Demon Empire!
The Demon Empire's nothing special, is it? Better just behave yourselves.
This is it, right here! I can smell the treasure from a mile away!
Commander Hazuki, what in the world is that enemy?
The space crime syndicate... the Gyandlar!
...They hadn't shown themselves in a while... Why now, of all times!?
Tch! They were supposedly searching for the Mutron, right?
Then it makes sense they'd show up, but...!
Yeah, they sure have lousy timing...!
Besides the demons, there are other fools who covet Mutron's power...!?
Besides the demons, there are other fools who covet Mutron's power...!?
What's all this!? You've been sayin' whatever you like!
You lot just hand over the treasure nice and quiet!
Nnngh, I won't let you do that, cutting in ahead of the Demon Empire!
The Bunker from Sharkin's report... No, the Gyandlar...!
Of all the times to come waltzing in!
We'll take on all of you at once!
The enemy won't wait for us to be ready...
Forget about their numbers! For now, just keep attacking!
Shiro, don't be too reckless...
There's no doubt the Hyper Libido's in this airspace. Get 'em!
If we dawdle, the boss lady's gonna chew us out!
Heh! Try it if you think you can!
What are you dawdling for!?
Geez! There's still more coming!?
S-Sorry... These guys are puttin' up a fight.
I don't want to hear excuses!
At this rate, how can I show my face to Lord Gades!?
The Gyandlar will be taking the Mutron!
Dammit! I won't hand over my mom... or the Mutron... to the likes of you!
Ku ku ku... All I need is to get my hands on this Mutron thing, you see.
Don't tell me... you're planning to kill Akira's mother!?
Gah! If Akira's mom dies, the Mutron
might vanish with her!?
If the energy just vanishes because one lousy human is gone,
then it never was the Hyper Libido after all!
That'd actually clear things up nicely.
...How could you...!
What a creep! Show, get her!
Hahahaha! You've got some nerve... Now, men! Finish them!
Kenrou! Grant me power!
I knew it! Rom! You little...!
Why are you on the surface!? Gardy and Globine were in space...!
Globine... I cut him down after a duel.
You cut down Globine!?
That was a good match... huh, Sis?
So that's what a fight between martial artists is like...!
Jet's Tenku Shinken was really sharp that time, after all.
Don't be rude, Jim... My sword is always sharp.
If it's me you're looking for, I'm right here! Diondra!
Wha-! You! Are you betraying Lord Gades... betraying us, the Gyandlar!?
I am a warrior... With them, I get to fight all sorts of opponents...
Globine's blade will now be wielded for justice! Diondra!
Traitor! I'll teach you what it means to turn your back
on the Gyandlar!
To betray one's own sword is a swordsman's shame...! I learned that!
Grrrr... Get them all!
Whoever defeats these fools and gets the Mutron
gets their Commander Ranking tripled!
Weren't you guys with Captain Bright?
We heard the Gyandlar were after the Mutron, so we came down.
You showed up at just the right time!
Diondra... You'll pay here for deceiving my brother and me!
My sister and I are never gonna forgive you Gyandlar!
Don't run your mouths, you brats!
We can't let the Gyandlar have the Mutron! Intercept them!
Whoa, this is bad! Retreat! You'll pay for this!
Gahahaha... All bark and no bite...
Shouldn't we go after them? Master Rom?
Right now, wiping out the enemies in this area comes first!
Tch, seems today's just not my day. Don't think it'll go like this next time!
You'd better be ready!
It is we of the Demon Empire who shall claim the Mutron!
Oh! Diondra's running away. Rom, should we chase her?
No... Let's make ending this battle our priority.
We can't just leave them be, after all.
I don't know what this Demon Empire is, but...
the Gyandlar will be taking the Hyper Libido!
Hyper Libido... You mean the Mutron? I won't allow it!
Lady Elle, it seems we've succeeded in wiping out the enemy.
So it would seem.
Everyone... thank you for rescuing me from danger.
I'm glad we were able to rescue you safely.
How did you know I was here?
Dad... Dad contacted us...
He did? I see... So you were the ones who saved me from Sharkin...?
Once again, you have my deepest thanks.
The tablet Dr. Hibiki found in Tibet
had a record of this place.
I see...
Still, how did the demons and the Gyandlar find this place?
The Demon Empire seemed to have followed Mom here, but...
They must have detected the energy of the Star of La Mu.
The Star of La Mu?
What exactly does that have to do with the Mutron?
The Star of La Mu that I found here is the key that unlocks
the Mutron energy...
So that is why I sense such strong energy.
The Hyper Libido, a mystic power passed down on planet Cronos...
Gades is after the Mutron in its place...
We can still make it, Big Bro! Let's go after Diondra!
Knowing them, they'll just round up more of their buddies
and come after that Star of La Mu again.
Should we strike before they can regroup...?
So, everyone... it's goodbye again.
I see... Knowing you, I'm sure you'll be fine, but
please, be careful.
Akira... I'll be heading straight to Mutropolis.
To Dad?
I must analyze this Star of La Mu and the tablet I found here.
But if they're after the Star of La Mu, won't that be dangerous?
The Big Shell... should be able to hold out against the enemy for a while...
And I have the Star of La Mu as well... There's no need to worry so much.
I see... Then at least, before heading to our next destination, let's stop by
Mutropolis...
Thank you for everything...
All right, all units, return to your ships.
